title: Listing technical exceptions and message guidance
content:
Purpose:
This working doc collects non-standard technical failure modes we run into during marketplace / cloud listing preflight and standardizes how GTM and Partner Ops communicate: partner-facing copy, internal triage guidance, and platform remediation steps. Focus: edge-case technical rejections (not legal/compliance) and consistent, empathetic language for partners.

Scope and audience:
- Audience: Partner managers, partner engineering, listing reviewers, support, and SRE/infra on-call.
- Not legal or billing policy language — separate playbooks exist.
- Use when listing fails automated QA checks or when technical artifacts (images, container, AMI, manifest) are malformed or nonstandard.

Quick summary (TL;DR):
- We categorize exceptions into: artifact-format, runtime-failure, integration-mismatch, telemetry/observability gaps, and infra-capacity conflicts.
- Each category has: a triage checklist, severity (P2/P3), sample partner message, internal note template, and recommended owner.
- Use the templates verbatim where possible; capture custom details in the bracketed placeholders.

Exception categories and triage checklist:
1) Artifact-format errors (e.g., manifest schema mismatch, missing tile images, corrupt archive) — typical cause: partner export tool version mismatch or manual editing.
  Triage steps:
  - Confirm error from automated validator (take validator output snippet).
  - Reproduce locally using partner artifact (or ask partner for fresh upload).
  - Validate against our schema v2.1 (link to schema in Confluence).
  - Severity: P3 if cosmetic (missing screenshot) — P2 if prevents listing tile creation or install.
  - Owner: Partner Eng + Listing Review.
  Partner-facing message (short):
  "Hi [Partner Name], thanks for your submission. Our preflight validator flagged a problem with the uploaded package: [short validator error]. Can you re-export using the Marketplace packaging tool v[expected-version] and re-upload? If you prefer, we can accept a fixed artifact; please attach a new file. — [PM name]"
  Internal note example:
  "Validator output: [paste]. Repro steps tried: local unpack -> schema validation -> fail. Suspected cause: partner used legacy exporter (vX). Next action: request new artifact + offer quick script to repackage."

2) Runtime-failure (image/AMI fails to boot, container exits on healthcheck)
  Triage steps:
  - Pull logs from our smoke runner/CI.
  - Check healthcheck definition and timeout.
  - Confirm base image compat (OS kernel/cloud-image mismatch).
  - Attempt ephemeral run in staging environment.
  - Severity: P2 (blocks listing) — escalate to SRE after 45m if no repro.
  - Owner: SRE + Partner Eng.
  Partner copy (empathetic + action):
  "Hi [Partner], during our automated runtime test your image failed to reach a healthy state: [short log excerpt]. Common fixes: increase healthcheck timeout, ensure /start script is executable, or rebuild using our recommended base image [base-image-ref]. Can you push a test image tagged [tag] and notify us? — [Oncall/Partner Eng]"

3) Integration-mismatch (auth, entitlements, IAM roles missing or wrong scopes)
  Triage steps:
  - Recreate the auth flow using test account.
  - Confirm role policies and scope lists against our integration checklist.
  - If third-party connectors are involved, verify token TTL and redirect URIs.
  - Severity: P2 if blocks marketplace SaaS onboarding; P3 otherwise.
  - Owner: Solutions Eng + Security liaison.
  Partner message (concise):
  "We hit an auth error while exercising connector flows: [error code]. Please confirm [role/policy] is present and that redirect URIs include [uri]. If you want, we can run a quick remote session to confirm. — [SE name]"

4) Telemetry / observability gaps (missing logs, metric labels not present)
  Triage steps:
  - Check that required syslog/structured events are emitted at startup and during sample traffic.
  - Confirm metric names/labels match our template.
  - Severity: P3 for GA readiness; P2 if prevents us from verifying SLAs.
  - Owner: Observability/Product Ops.
  Partner copy (education-focused):
  "Our verification harness didn't find the expected start/error logs. To pass smoke tests we need: a structured start event (name: marketplace.start) and an error event with label 'marketplace.error'. We've attached a small sample logger shim you can add. — [Observability]"

5) Infra-capacity conflicts (region not supported, instance types incompatible)
  Triage steps:
  - Confirm region flags in listing config.
  - Cross-check with capacity catalog (internal doc).
  - If partner expects reserved capacity mapping, confirm SKU entitlements.
  - Severity: P2 if partner needs region/instance for acceptance testing; otherwise P3.
  - Owner: Capacity Planning + Partner Ops.
  Partner copy (informative):
  "Heads up — the requested region [region] currently maps to a compatible instance family in preview only. For now, we can run verification in [alt-region] or schedule a limited capacity test. Which would you prefer? — [Capacity PM]"

Communication best-practices (short):
- Start with the specific failure and a short log snippet (1–2 lines).
- Offer a suggested fix and, when feasible, a one-click/one-snippet remediation.
- Give next steps with a clear owner and an ETA: "we'll re-run validation when you upload" or "we'll schedule a remote test within 48h".
- Avoid technical jargon in partner-facing copy; keep an optional internal-technical block in the same thread for Eng folks.

Standard templates (copy) — use these as-is and replace bracketed parts:
A) Short automated rejection email (sent by the listing system):
  Subject: Action needed — technical issue on your Marketplace listing: [app-name]
  Body:
  Hi [Partner Name],

  Our automated preflight checks found a technical issue preventing us from publishing your listing: [one-line reason].

  What to do next:
  1) Re-upload a corrected artifact (see attached validator output).
  2) If you'd like live help, reply and we'll set up a 30-minute session.

  We'll re-run checks as soon as a new artifact is available. Thanks!

  — [Redwood Marketplace Team]

B) Internal triage summary (Slack snippet to #marketplace-triage):
  [SHORT] Listing failed: [app-name] — category: [artifact-format|runtime|auth|telemetry|capacity] — severity: [P2/P3]
  Summary: [one-line]
  Validator/log excerpt: [one-liner]
  Next action: [request artifact / schedule test / escalate to SRE] — owner: [name] — ETA: [48h]

C) Public help center note sample (short):
  Title: Why did my listing fail preflight?
  Body: Our preflight checks validate package format, startup behavior, auth contracts, and basic observability. Common causes: incorrect packaging tool version, container healthcheck failures, missing IAM scopes, or region capacity mismatches. Follow the guidance in the upload checklist and contact partner-support@redwood.ai if you need a review.

Decision matrix (quick):
- If issue stops install/listing → escalate P2 and open incident with SRE.
- If issue is cosmetic or docs-only → P3, partner PM owns fix.
- If fix requires infra changes (new instance family, region enablement) → Capacity team kickoff, include partner in planning.

Open questions / items to finalize (TODOs):
- Agree canonical schema version for artifact validation and make validator return stable error codes (Maya assigned).
- Create one-click repackage CLI for partners (Dev Ex spike).
- Add a webhook for partner notifications when we auto-retry validation (product decision).
- Determine SLA for re-validation after partner re-upload (default 24 hours).

Appendix — quick troubleshooting snippets (for us to paste into messages):
- Validator: run `marketplace-validate --schema v2.1 <archive>`
- Local boot: `docker run --rm -it -p 8080:8080 <image>:test-sanity --health-interval 10s`
- Sample log filter: `jq -r '.event | select(.name=="marketplace.start")'`

Notes to reviewers:
- This is intentionally compact; we want minimal partner friction. Please flag any customer-facing phrasing that sounds too internal.
- If approved, we'll add these templates to the partner portal and hook the short automated rejection email up to the listing system.

Historical context / why this doc exists (short):
We repeatedly see the same small set of technical failures cause listings to stall. Partner teams reported inconsistent messages; partners escalate to CSMs. Standardizing reduces back-and-forth and accelerates time-to-publish.

Owners / next steps:
- Maya: finalize validator error codes (JIRA-MLIST-3128) — due 2026-02-10
- Liam: prototype one-click repackage script (PR created) — due 2026-02-24
- Priya: coordinate partner portal copy update and signoff with Legal — due 2026-03-05

(End of draft — comments welcome)
